limits: Independent AI static/numerical/language review is not human technical, fluent-language, musician, participant or transfer validation.
Native helper execution is standalone unchanged F# source plus a temporary wrapper; coordinate adapter and temporal enumeration are authored calculations, not an implemented GA integration.
Static pitch/chord helpers are not failed temporal planners; current model proves only declared fixed-string independent-sustain feasibility and does not certify physical playability or sound.
Timing annotations are invented; least-squares fitting is in-sample and does not establish groove, genre, preference, player skill, actual integer-BPM playback drift or learning.
Tuning MCP responses do not attest deployed runtime revision or temporal behavior. Proposed repairs do not imply musician permission or a playing trial.
Rendered/deployed HTML and publication bytes were not inspected by this reviewer; integration and anonymous publication checks are separate.
